about_the_game:
Taste of Power: Medieval is a real-time strategy game about strategic thinking, speed and massive battles. Immerse yourself in an alternate medieval world where Europe, China, and the Timurid Caliphate clash for dominion over the New World.

Smart Action System

We’ve reimagined the classic RTS experience. Our intuitive UI puts effortless control of hundreds of troops with a few clicks while still offering precise unit micromanagement when you want it.

Routine micromanagement is intelligently automated, letting you focus on what truly matters: grand strategy, bold battlefield maneuvers, and the overall evolution of your empire.

Three Unique Civilizations

Master three distinct factions, each with exclusive units, technologies, and strategic advantages:

  • Europe: Heavily armored troops supported by advanced gunpowder artillery.

  • China: Vast armies equipped with early rocket technology.

  • Timurid Caliphate: Mobile forces backed by deadly incendiary weapons.

Every unit comes with its own strengths and weaknesses, creating a tactical rock-paper-scissors system that rewards creativity and smart battlefield decisions.

Endless Strategic Possibilities

Multiple technology trees and development branches within each faction let you craft your perfect war machine. Go all-in on impenetrable defense, relentless aggression, rapid expansion, or daring technological gambles… Every choice shapes your civilization’s future and unlocks new tactical options.

Unprecedented Medieval Arsenal

Experience one of the most diverse weapon systems ever featured in a medieval RTS. Rain down devastating artillery fire, construct powerful fortifications, deploy early missile weapons, harness alchemical warfare, and unleash fiery incendiary attacks. Master these tools to turn the tide of battle— even when defeat seems certain.

Demo content

Two campaigns with 8 missions each await you. In the first, you will be able to master the management and discover the European armies. In the second campaign, you will be able to immerse yourself in challenges to prove your strategic skills.

The Ultimate Strategic Test

Victory demands split-second decisions under relentless pressure. Can you adapt your strategy on the fly? Will you outthink and outmaneuver your enemies when every moment counts?

Prove your tactical supremacy in this revolutionary take on medieval warfare. Command vast armies, forge mighty empires, and discover what it truly means to have a Taste of Power: Medieval.
